query: WITH filtered_graduates AS (SELECT gpa FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala WHERE TRIM(major_classification_parent_name) LIKE '%حاسب%' AND gpa IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(gpa) AS average_cumulative_gpa FROM filtered_graduates where gpa between 1 and 5 LIMIT 1200;
raw_question: ما متوسط المعدل التراكمي (GPA) عند التخرج لطلاب الحاسب؟
